correctness.rationale: Exact substitution of the published two-stage CS-SAM update yields t_next=t|1-gamma F_rho(t)|. Strict F_rho decrease and strict (tF_rho) increase establish subcritical global contraction, the unique supercritical cycle and its global attraction despite overshoots; a reciprocal-increment proof yields the exact critical k^{-1} constant. Exact rational example rho=1, gamma=10/3 has two-cycle x=+-1/ell, and the standalone checker passes 11,865 auxiliary checks. These tests do not replace the infinite-dimensional quantifiers of the analytic proof; the theorem is scalar only.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact global classification of a new two-scale optimization update at every perturbation and step size, not merely local linear stability. It isolates a sharp convergence/nonoptimal-cycle boundary, the critical inverse-time coefficient, and a qualitative contrast with the constant-scale divergence law, giving a mathematically motivated parameter and curvature-scale sensitivity diagnostic. This precise question is not answered by the source paper’s conservative sufficient theory.
